name: Being A Man
overview: Scripture calls a man to courage and strength rooted in the presence of the LORD, as Joshua 1:9 encourages boldness without fear because God is always with him. True manhood is marked by a life that avoids ungodly counsel and sinful paths, delighting instead in God’s commandments and fearing the LORD, as Psalms 1:1 and 112:1 reveal. The godly man’s steps are ordered by the Lord, and his way is kept pure by adherence to God’s Word, exemplified in Psalms 37:23 and 119:9. Furthermore, Proverbs 27:17 highlights the importance of mutual encouragement and sharpening among men, underscoring the communal aspect of growing in godliness.
